stable_boundaries: AstrBot owns provider lifecycle, routing, fallback, retry, model-card management, and the shared Dashboard schema.
The plugin adapts Volcengine request and media protocols; it does not maintain a second global model-capability database.
Request transport settings are not permanent model-capability facts.
Provider-specific fields must not leak into foreign provider cards.
Development documentation, tests, evidence, and experiments stay outside the allow-list runtime package.
A passing gate proves only the object and layer named by that gate.
warning: Read verdict first. Stable release, active candidate, external observation, and stopped experiments are separate objects. Do not combine their green or red evidence into one project verdict.
